Salnytsya Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Vinnytsia Oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. Salnytsya's Jewish community likely settled after the 1648–49 Khmelnytsky uprising, growing fivefold to 903 people by 1897. Under Romanian occupation, more than 450 Jews were deported to the ghetto in nearby Ulaniv, documented elsewhere in this collection, and executed there along with local Jews on June 12, 1942. Local neighbors have formally cared for this cemetery since agreements signed in 1973 and 1992, including one Mr. Starikovsky of Vinnytsia, who asked his family to continue the role after him — though the site currently faces a real threat: local government plans to divide and privatize the land.
